findings.conclusion: Core PRIVATE static wrf_rrtmgp dependency is now included in the same WRF exported target set; PUBLIC module include paths are separated into BUILD_INTERFACE and relative INSTALL_INTERFACE. Installed Fortran modules are copied without changing backend source arithmetic. WRFConfig finds netCDF and netCDF-Fortran before loading target exports; the latter defines the required netCDF::netcdff target.

Both host interfaces now accept optional ordinary assumed-shape arrays with explicit ims/kms/jms lower bounds. solve_em passes whole grid fields plus the same memory bounds; start_em obtains bounds from get_ijk_from_grid and passes whole fields. Removing ASSOCIATED is appropriate: an unallocated allocatable or disassociated pointer actual is absent for an OPTIONAL nonallocatable nonpointer dummy. Nested PRESENT gates do not dereference absent arguments. No pointer reassociation is requested.

UDM has_reqc/has_reqi/has_reqs remain enabled only under the existing 37/37 coupling. The ordinary RA4 UDM branch is excluded from the general use_mp_re list and dedicated 37 flags. Cold-init and restart sentinel assignment conditions are unchanged. This establishes source isolation, not a new bitwise forecast comparison.

The three startup and three failed-restart-read sentinel assignment sites select ALLOCATED with USE_ALLOCATABLES and retain ASSOCIATED otherwise. Field names, -1 sentinels, restart predicates, and error policy are unchanged.

The new fixture extracts four exact preprocessor groups covering six assignment sites, compiles pointer and allocatable forms, and checks enabled/disabled, successful/failed read and absent-storage cases. It is a small guard fixture, not a full input_wrf or host-interface/bounds integration test. It was read only in this review.

limitations: No compilation, build, install, consumer execution, fixture execution, model forecast, RTE, or raw scientific capture read was performed by this reviewer. Root owns fresh v3 execution; this report does not assert its outcome.

Changing Fortran dummy pointer attributes changes the module interface contract; all affected callers and modules need rebuilding. Compatibility with previously compiled callers or mixed compiler .mod files is not claimed.

Unchanged WRFConfig embeds the install prefix in its module search path and existing Core configuration also contains absolute properties. General relocation of an installed WRF prefix is not established by this patch; an actual installed consumer check is needed for its advertised supported layout.

Direct standalone backend installation is outside the reviewed full-WRF export scope. Optional arrays retain the existing expectation of properly sized active whole-grid storage; this patch does not introduce shape validation.
